title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.7 NOVA TITAN - 100% Full Visibility Suite, Zero-Drop Mouse Engine & Discord RPC 2.0
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.7 NOVA TITAN: (1) 100% Full Catalog & Tab Visibility: Unlocked Custom Crosshair in sidebar by default, surfaced all 18 Game Booster catalog tweaks & all 29 App Optimizer tweaks (Edge, Chrome, Brave, Steam, Discord/VoiceMod, Razer/Logitech), and surfaced all 16 macro templates in both Local & Cloud modes. (2) Zero-Drop Mouse Engine: Upgraded mouclass packet ring buffer guard to >= 100 (128 high-polling preset) across Watchdog, Pro Packs, and Mouse Hz Studio so rapid clicks never drop on 1K-8KHz gaming mice. (3) Sprint Edit Momentum Fix: Preserves physical W forward hold without synthetic key interruption. (4) Process Monitor Upgrades: Grouped VoiceMod background daemons and added strict PowerToys protection. (5) Rebuilt Discord Rich Presence IPC pipe reader & 100% clean UTF-8 icon rendering with zero mojibake.
